spec.claim_summary: Buy Nikkei 225 stocks on daily close crossing above the 80-day +1-sigma band and sell on close crossing below the middle band.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim trades all 225 Nikkei 225 components separately and aggregates constituent-level signals; engine tests single-symbol rules so assets uses NIKKEI225 as closest proxy, which is not the same test.
Bollinger middle band is the 80-period SMA by standard definition; exit uses close crosses_below sma(80).
Entry uses close crosses_above bb_upper(80, 1.0) to represent price crossing above the +1-sigma line.
Next-day open execution matches engine fill at next bar open on bar closes.
No stop, target, trailing stop or max hold stated; exit is only via middle-band cross.
Test Period January 4, 2000 - December 30, 2024 is evaluation window, not part of rule, stored in claimed.

evidence.quote: Buy at the next day’s open using a market order
Price crosses above the +1σ line from below
If the price crosses below the middle band, sell at the next day’s open using a market order

audit_majors: assets: Claim requires trading all components of the Nikkei 225 separately and aggregating; spec tests single NIKKEI225 symbol as proxy, which is not the same test and could change the verdict.
